```yaml
name: Regenerate translations

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  regenerate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get changed ARB files
        id: changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          format: csv
          filter: 'lib/l10n/.*\\.arb'

      - name: Set up Flutter via FVM
        id: fvm
        uses: kuhnroyal/flutter-fvm-config-action@fcdb62b682dade6f0d9e0c6eae6acc647ca8c31d
        with:
          path: .fvm/fvm_config.json
          setup: true

      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: ${{ steps.fvm.outputs.FLUTTER_CHANNEL }}
          flutter-version: ${{ steps.fvm.outputs.FLUTTER_VERSION }}
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Activate intl_utils
        run: flutter pub global activate intl_utils

      - name: Generate translations
        run: flutter pub global run intl_utils:generate

      - name: Commit generated files
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.modified != ''
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add lib/generated
          git commit -m "Regenerate translations" || echo "No changes to commit"
        id: commit

      - name: Push changes
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.modified != ''
        run: |
          git remote set-url origin https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}
          git push origin HEAD:regen-translations-${{ github.sha }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.modified != ''
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          title: "Regenerate translations"
          body: |
            This PR regenerates translation files after changes to ARB files.
          branch: regen-translations-${{ github.sha }}
          base: main
```
